recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring two mirrored versions of a woman with an afro and striped headband, seated on a dark, textured floor. The lighting is dramatic with a central glow, highlighting leather-like clothing and metallic jewelry against a dark, moody background.
coreVisualRelationships: Mirror-image symmetry between the two subjects
Contrast between dark leather textures and bright white headband stripes
Central vertical axis for all typographic elements
Warm, low-key lighting creating a spotlight effect on the floor
coreInvariants: Seated pose with knees drawn up

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale figures positioned on the left and right thirds, facing inward toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central vertical column of text and the large graphic ampersand.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces, move down the central text column, and rest on the large horizontal name at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, shadowy areas at the top corners and between the two figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white in the headbands and jewelry highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold for the central graphic and deep red for the primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses a heavy, wide serif with custom ligatures and elongated horizontal strokes.
Secondary text uses a vertical stack with high tracking.
Subtitle uses a fluid, casual script.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters in the main name feature extended crossbars that connect to adjacent letters.
Large, translucent ampersand acting as a background graphic for the central text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, custom display serif paired with a light, vertically-stacked serif and a casual script for contrast.

preserve: Extended horizontal bars in main name

candidateDirections.reason: For the small, wide-tracked central text.
For the display text's decorative serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical photo of a woman with an afro and a black-and-white striped headband, wearing black leather, seated on a dark textured floor with a central spotlight effect. Mirror the figure on the left and right sides.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, wide red serif name at the bottom. In the center, place a large translucent gold ampersand with white vertically-stacked serif text layered on top. Add a small script subtitle above the ampersand.

verificationChecks: Is the main name at the bottom wide and red?
Is there a large ampersand in the center?
Are the headbands striped black and white?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the central light flare
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Check for proper vertical alignment of central text.
Ensure the red text at the bottom is legible against the dark floor.
Verify the mirrored poses look intentional and balanced.
Confirm the striped pattern on the headbands is crisp.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical dual-portrait + central vertical typography + high-contrast monochrome accessories + warm low-key lighting.
